scope.per_frame_matching: Existing IoU>=0.5 thresholded Hungarian matching against positive class1DevGT; this offline labeling differs from official HOTA global matching.
scope.ground_truth_concentration: PerGT largest predicted-track share conditional on matched observations. Labels from the entireDev sequence, not causal inference.
scope.track_purity: Perpredicted-track largestGT share on same matched observations.
scope.bijective_concentration: Maximal contingency-matrix assignment mass divided by matched observations; a descriptive offline score, not official IDF1/AssA.
scope.run_scope: Contiguous matched frame/track pieces; gaps break pieces. Nondominant means outside the largestGT/track contingency cell, not a certified error label.
scope.restrictions: No predictor, quality rule, threshold, model or Test routing selected from these annotations. GT box overlap is only a proxy, not measured occlusion.
